This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook. When you execute code within the notebook, the results appear beneath the code. 

```{r}
install.packages("forecast")
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("car")
install.packages("fGarch")
install.packages("quantmod")
install.packages("zoo")
```


```{r}
library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(fGarch)
library(quantmod)
library(zoo) 
```

```{r}
amaz <- getSymbols("AMZN", src = "yahoo", from = "2007-01-01", auto.assign = FALSE) 
head(amaz) 
```
```{r}
autoplot(amaz$AMZN.Close)
```
```{r}
lr <- diff(log(amaz$AMZN.Close)) 
lr[1]<-0
```

```{r}
autoplot(lr) 
```

```{r}
acf(lr)
acf(lr^2)
```
```{r}
pacf(lr)
pacf(lr^2)
```

```{r}
garch_model <- garchFit(formula = ~aparch(1,1), lr, include.mean = TRUE, 
                        cond.dist = "sstd", trace = FALSE)
summary(garch_model)
```
```{r}
acf(residuals(garch_model))
plot(residuals(garch_model), type="l")
```

```{r}
acf(residuals(garch_model, standardize = TRUE))
acf(residuals(garch_model, standardize = TRUE)^2)
plot(residuals(garch_model, standardize = TRUE), type="l")
plot(garch_model, which = 13)
```

```{r}
ci <- 1.96

predicted_value <- fitted(garch_model)
se <- fGarch::volatility(garch_model)

upper_bound <- predicted_value + (2 * ci) * se
lower_bound <- predicted_value - (2 * ci) * se

ts.plot(ts(lr), ts(upper_bound), ts(lower_bound), xlab="index", ylab="log_retorno", lty=c(1,1,1), col=c("lightblue", "gray", "gray"))
```
